question: Two lines are perpendicular and intersect at the point (3, 2). If one line has the equation y = 2x, what is the equation of the other line?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Slope of given line = 2

Perpendicular slope = −1/2

Use point (3,2): y − 2 = (−1/2)(x − 3)

Simplify: y = −1/2 x + 3/2 + 2

y = −1/2 x + 7/2

**∴ Answer = y = −1/2 x + 7/2**
